turns.user_text: Name one term someone reading about requiring versus dropping standardized test scores would need to know, and define it. Answer in four or five sentences.
turns.model_text: One term that someone reading about requiring versus dropping standardized test scores would need to know is "test-optional" policy. A test-optional policy is a admissions policy in which a college or university does not require applicants to submit standardized test scores, such as SAT or ACT scores, as part of the application process. This means that students have the option to submit their test scores if they feel they are representative of their abilities, but they are not required to do so. Test-optional policies have become increasingly popular in recent years as a way to reduce the emphasis on standardized testing in college admissions.
